news.title: Flyers winless in 7 games, their worst start in franchise history

news.title: Hurricanes send Flyers to franchise-record 7th straight loss to open season

news.title: Without Shesterkin, New York Rangers lean on Garand in win

news.description: Two days after losing starting goaltender Igor Shesterkin for the season with a knee injury, Dylan Garand, 24, made 19 saves and the New York Rangers defeated the Vancouver Canucks 6-2 on Sunday night at Madison Square Garden, the club's fifth victory.
